thread.title: Indian shares slip, financials drag By Reuters

author: Reuters
title: Indian shares slip, financials drag By Reuters
text:
Indian shares slip, financials drag * NSE index down 0.28 pct, BSE index 0.15 pct lower
* Vodafone (LON: VOD ) Idea falls after subscriber data
By Tanvi Mehta
Jan 3 (Reuters) - Indian shares tracked global markets lower on Thursday hurt by declines in the financial sector, as investors remained cautious ahead of the start of corporate earnings season next week.
U.S. stock futures fell and Asian shares wobbled after a rare revenue warning from Apple Inc AAPL.O added to worries about slowing global growth and weaker earnings. MKTS/GLOB
"People are waiting for triggers," said Jayant Manglik, president of retail distribution at Religare Broking in New Delhi.
"Issues on the global front for the next few weeks will have to be watched," he said, while expressing optimism about corporate earnings.
Top software services exporters Tata Consultancy Services Ltd TCS.NS and Infosys Ltd INFY.NS are set to report results for the December-quarter earnings next week.
The broader NSE index .NSEI was down 0.28 percent at 10,762.70 as of 0536 GMT, while the benchmark BSE index .BSESN was 0.15 percent lower at 35,837.17.
Financial stocks pulled the indexes lower, with Housing Development Finance Corp HDFC.NS and HDFC Bank HDBK.NS leading the decline.
Energy stocks also took a beating, with Hindustan Petroleum Corp Ltd HPCL.NS and Oil and Natural Gas Corp ONGC.NS falling 3 percent and 2.3 percent respectively. They were the top percentage decliners on the NSE index.
Eicher Motors Ltd EICH.NS fell for the second day after reporting weak sales for December.
Telecom firms Vodafone Idea Ltd VODA.NS and Bharti Airtel Ltd BRTI.NS fell 2.2 percent and 0.5 percent respectively, after monthly data showed only a modest increase in India's mobile phone customer base. of state-run Dena Bank DENA.NS and Vijaya Bank VJBK.NS tumbled after the cabinet approved their merger with Bank of Baroda BOB.NS .
